review_comments: I'm just wondering what was the point for this test case in the first place when the only supported page sizes are `hugepages-2Mi` and `hugepages-1Gi`. Is there something that needs to be fixed in the implementation not to allow arbitrary sizes at the validation stage before they get to `etcd`?

Or actually that's the implementation and therefore this test case will always fail; should we then test for that failure and also redo the wording, re: `"huge pages with size 3Mi should be supported"`.

Ok, got, this is historical... https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/commit/2830827442358235a729b39e5eed8ec6cda29e12

but perhaps still needs a relook into it.
